# Iteration 007: common coalescence-time phase scan

First seeded strong-HOM point in each NSBH/BBH stream (seed 20261017), both PSDs, L=5 and L=50. All intrinsic and other extrinsic parameters fixed. 21 equally spaced t_c in [T-2.12,T-1.9]. Each row is HH(t_c)/HH(first)-1; the exact HH is time independent. Phase is recomputed by XHMCoarseEvaluator at every time. All mode tails are retained.

The common phase cancels analytically in every mode product and in total |h|^2. Thus pairwise, B0 AND linear interpolation must be constant to roundoff. Only methods that interpolate the complex waveform (IFFT-FFT, B1 in bands actually using FFTs) can vary. At L=50 adaptive B1 uses B0 and is constant too. The expectation that linear varies is incompatible with its Eqs. (27)-(30) power-only formula.
